verdict.rationale: Entra Domain Services is documented as providing cloud LDAP (and Kerberos/NTLM) for legacy apps that can't do modern auth, directly supporting the LDAP half of the story, but no evidence anywhere in the pack mentions a cloud RADIUS endpoint or RADIUS support for VPN/Wi-Fi scenarios. Missing for 10: documentation of a native cloud RADIUS server/endpoint, VPN/Wi-Fi RADIUS integration examples, and independent confirmation these legacy protocol endpoints work reliably in production.
